hypothesis: A random canonical-coefficient search screened on the complete circle metric and then gated on the full taxi metric can discover a candidate below the independently reproduced 5-violation seed now that the streaming taxi evaluator is practical.
rationale: The pinned upstream README documents that random candidates can reach a 3-violation vector, and the first pinned seed already scores 5 locally. The prior shared-cache run reached 700 circle candidates but could not taxi-score them because it used one nested worker; the streaming capability run showed eight workers complete a full candidate in about 528 seconds. Releasing the circle cache before full scoring combines the cheap complete-circle filter with the newly practical exact taxi gate.
expected_information_gain: Tests the documented search mechanism under a stable local runtime and determines whether complete-circle candidates contain a path below 5 without relying on the falsified five-edge proxy.
method: Use the pinned search source's exact build_ck4_cache, mutate_vector, and evaluate_ck4_cached functions. Build one circle B cache, generate deduplicated candidates for 600 seconds from seed_dense, seed_sparse, mutate_ck4, mutate_proxy, mutate_timed, and mutate_full with seed 20260827, and retain the two lowest full-circle violation candidates. Explicitly release the circle cache, then evaluate the two finalists sequentially on all taxi edges using the pinned stage-D logic with eight streaming workers. Stop at the first full result below 3. Independently reproduce any target result with the unmodified evaluator entrypoint.
metric: primary: exact full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k; screening: exact complete circle_k4_m6 violations_k
metric_relation_to_true_objective: Only a completed full taxi result below 3 reaches the frozen finite target. Circle scores are a complete-instance proxy and cannot establish target progress by themselves.

configuration.cache_lifecycle: build one circle cache, release before taxi scoring
configuration.evaluator: pinned stage-D logic; independent evaluator required for any target result

compute_budget.cpu: one circle-search process plus eight bounded taxi potential workers per sequential finalist
compute_budget.memory_intent: circle cache released before streaming taxi evaluation

kill_condition: Stop at the first full result below 3, after two full finalists, at 2400 seconds, or at a precise runtime failure. Do not infer target progress from circle-only scores.

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict target progress only if a full finalist scores below 3

previous_best_comparison.shared_cache_circle_search: 700 candidates; no taxi score with one nested worker
previous_best_comparison.targeted_repair: 348550 full violations for both proxy finalists
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: new complete-circle screening plus eight-worker taxi gate

repetition_justification: This revisits the documented random candidate family only after a material capability change: complete full taxi scoring with eight streaming workers, plus explicit cache release. It does not repeat fixed-edge repair or the prior one-worker shared-cache run.
